instruction: Install Nextcloud with Apache on Debian 12
output: sudo apt install nextcloud-server && sudo -u www-data nextcloud.occ maintenance:install --database mysql --database-name nextcloud --database-user root --database-pass password --admin-user admin --admin-pass admin123

instruction: Install and set up DAViCal CalDAV
output: sudo apt install davical && sudo -u postgres createdb -O davical_app davical && sudo -u www-data /usr/share/davical/configure-database.php

instruction: Restart Apache after DAViCal install
Test DAViCal with cadaver
Verify WebDAV is working with Apache dav module
Check mod_dav module loaded in Apache
Enable Apache dav_lock module
output: sudo a2enmod dav_lock && sudo systemctl reload apache2

instruction: Set WebDAV directory with DAVMinProp in Apache
output: echo 'DAVMinPropTimeOut 30' | sudo tee /etc/apache2/conf-available/dav-min-prop.conf && sudo a2enconf dav-min-prop && sudo systemctl reload apache2

instruction: Configure Apache WebDAV without authentication
output:
echo 'Alias /public /var/www/public
<Directory /var/www/public>
    DAV On
    Require all granted
</Directory>' | sudo tee /etc/apache2/sites-available/public-dav.conf && sudo a2ensite public-dav.conf && sudo systemctl reload apache2
